taxonomy.rule: Each idea has one primary state. Monitoring is a separate activity attached to that idea.

definitions.INVESTIGATING: Research is active; no final verdict yet.
definitions.PURSUE: Current evidence supports an actionable asymmetric thesis.
definitions.WATCH: A real path survives with a finite promotion, kill and expiry plan.
definitions.TREND_NOTE: The observation is real but lacks a material listed path or differentiated catalyst.
definitions.STANDING_MONITOR: Known or user-supplied thesis tracked separately from blind discovery yield.
definitions.REJECTED: A core thesis, materiality, parity, event or implementation gate failed.
definitions.ARCHIVED: Historical result retained for audit but not active under the current contract.

ideas.title: Current airline delay and compensation economics
ideas.why: A dated current European network disruption exists, but no carrier-specific affected-flight, passenger, claim or care-cost count was found. IAG has the strongest exact path and a finite 6 November Q3 check; TUI and Air France-KLM remain context, not separate live trades.

transition_plan.missing_assertion: The 24-30 August/ongoing disruption created BA/IAG-specific compensation, care, rebooking or capacity costs above IAG's July plan and dated consensus.
transition_plan.resolution_source: EUROCONTROL weekly reports, IAG/BA operational notices or RNS, IAG Q3 release and updated IAG official consensus.
transition_plan.next_check: Check the next published EUROCONTROL weekly overview and issuer notices; hard checkpoint 6 November 2026 IAG Q3, with price review after the first full trading session.
transition_plan.promotion_condition: Primary carrier-level counts plus a defensible cost/revenue bound that moves IAG outside dated guidance/consensus, with a still-unabsorbed price implication and feasible common-stock risk plan.
transition_plan.kill_condition: No carrier-specific cost disclosure, normalization before material impact, extraordinary-circumstance/operational mitigation contains costs, or the effect remains inside guidance and price.
transition_plan.expiry: 9 November 2026 after the first complete post-Q3 LSE session.

ideas.next_check: Check the next published EUROCONTROL weekly overview and issuer notices; hard checkpoint 6 November 2026 IAG Q3, with price review after the first full trading session.
ideas.kill_condition: No carrier-specific cost disclosure, normalization before material impact, extraordinary-circumstance/operational mitigation contains costs, or the effect remains inside guidance and price.

ideas.title: FirstRand / FNB banking app
ideas.why: The app-to-listed-parent mechanism is real and FNB is material to FirstRand, but app-attributable earnings and a differentiated expectation are not disclosed. The 10 September FY2026 result is a finite resolution event.
ideas.detail: The frozen run observed +60% seven-day Rising for the exact FNB banking-app query. FirstRand's latest H1 disclosure separately reported 390 million app transactions, up 8%, 8.0 million digitally active customers and R49.7 billion transacted through 6.2 million activated virtual cards.
ideas.catalyst: FirstRand FY2026 results on 10 September 2026, followed by the first complete market session and any management presentation/call detail.

transition_plan.missing_assertion: Incremental FNB app engagement is producing material FirstRand earnings beyond activity already embedded in management disclosure and expectations.
transition_plan.resolution_source: FirstRand FY2026 release, FNB segment analysis, management presentation/call and a dated consensus comparison.
transition_plan.next_check: 10 September 2026 FY2026 results; complete the price/consensus check after the first full JSE session on 11 September 2026.
transition_plan.promotion_condition: Fresh app-specific or tightly attributable digital economics, a defensible group earnings bridge, an implication above dated expectations, and a feasible FSR common-stock entry/risk plan.
transition_plan.kill_condition: No attribution, no expectation gap, deteriorating economics, or no executable common-stock route.
transition_plan.expiry: 11 September 2026 after the first complete post-results session.

ideas.next_check: 10 September 2026 FY2026 results; complete the price/consensus check after the first full JSE session on 11 September 2026.
ideas.kill_condition: No attribution, no expectation gap, deteriorating economics, or no executable common-stock route.

ideas.detail: Search interest rose around a new Singapore Airlines Business Class product; SIA says it will unveil next-generation long-haul cabins toward end-2026 under a previously announced SGD1.1 billion, 41-aircraft A350 retrofit.
ideas.catalyst: End-2026 cabin unveiling, followed by retrofit deployment and premium-yield/load-factor disclosure.

transition_plan.missing_assertion: The premium-cabin refresh can lift yield or premium demand enough to exceed expectations after retrofit costs.

ideas.title: HOLY soft drink
ideas.why: HOLY is a private German company and no primary-sourced, plausibly material listed path was found.
ideas.next_check: Independent repeat purchasing outside creator or affiliate communities
ideas.kill_condition: Repeat purchasing fails to replicate outside the concentrated creator community.

ideas.title: Modine / Canadian data-center cooling demand
ideas.why: Global cooling demand and issuer exposure are verified, but no Canadian project, customer or order was found. The global thesis is already explicit in results, the $4bn agreement, backlog and sharp event reactions; the Canadian Rising lead supplies no differentiated security-level catalyst.
ideas.detail: Canada showed +150% seven-day Rising for a category query. Modine has a Calgary manufacturing footprint, but the primary record names no Canadian end-customer or project. The strongest disclosed demand is a global/US hyperscale agreement and large US colocation orders at Munters.
ideas.catalyst: A named Canadian data-center customer/project/order or an issuer filing that isolates Canadian production, shipment value and timing; absent that, only ordinary quarterly backlog/margin conversion remains.
ideas.kill_condition: No Canada-specific primary evidence; hyperscale agreement proves nonbinding or converts below plan; component bottlenecks persist; or cooling growth fails to recover margins.

ideas.title: Noise Clutch headphones
instruments: No direct listed exposure; Amber Enterprises India Ltd. is an indirect watch path only
ideas.why: Noise/Nexxbase is private. Amber's Stelltek relationship is real, but no filing ties Clutch production or revenue to Stelltek and Stelltek reported zero turnover in FY2023-24 and FY2024-25.
ideas.next_check: Amber filing that identifies Clutch or Noise audio production at Stelltek
ideas.kill_condition: No independent delivered-use replication, no Clutch attribution, or continued immaterial Stelltek economics.

ideas.detail: Marvell, Lumentum and Corning all have official AI data-center customer, product or growth evidence. Those same links, purchase commitments and capacity plans are explicit in company disclosures. The system found real suppliers, then correctly rejected them for high parity and missing price underreaction.

ideas.title: AI data-centre skilled-trades bottleneck
ideas.why: Quanta reported Q2 revenue USD9.56 billion, total backlog USD53.4 billion and raised 2026 revenue guidance to USD39.3-39.7 billion; Q1 electric backlog was USD40.1 billion, driven partly by new large-load awards.
ideas.detail: US searches rose for data-centre skilled trades; Quanta directly links craft-skilled labour and training to large-load project execution.

signals.query: ai data center skilled trades demand

ideas.catalyst: Further large-load awards or disclosure of data-centre-specific revenue, labour pricing and margin.
ideas.kill_condition: Backlog delays/cancellations, hyperscale capex slows, or labour scarcity hurts margins rather than pricing.

ideas.title: Australia data-centre water constraint
ideas.why: The operating constraint is official; Sydney Water is unlisted, and no exact listed operator water contract, cost or supplier order was verified.
ideas.detail: Sydney Water says data centres have high water demand and is prioritising recycled water, infrastructure planning and fair pricing.
ideas.kill_condition: No named facility economics or listed pass-through.

ideas.title: Australia EV tax-concession review
ideas.why: The archived Treasury review recommends managing the programme's growing cost; no selected OEM's Australian earnings sensitivity is provided.
ideas.detail: Australia's statutory review estimates the EV discount drove about 64,000 additional BEV sales through December 2025, while annual tax expenditure could rise from AUD1.35 billion in 2025/26 to AUD2.8 billion in 2028/29.

signals.query: australia electric car tax break changes

ideas.catalyst: Enacted eligibility/phase-down changes plus OEM disclosure of Australian fleet effects.
ideas.kill_condition: Recommendations are not adopted or issuer volumes are insensitive.

ideas.title: Frigidaire built-in dishwasher
instruments: AB Electrolux B shares, Nasdaq Stockholm: ELUX B
ideas.why: The signal is repair/workaround behavior, not incremental demand; failure incidence and current-model exposure are unknown, and Electrolux does not disclose Frigidaire dishwasher economics.
ideas.kill_condition: Failures do not replicate outside repair forums, are confined to old models, warranty rates are normal, or repair dominates replacement.

ideas.title: India August EV registrations
ideas.why: A Lok Sabha answer covers PM E-DRIVE data only through 30 June and 9,583 public chargers as of 1 July; the 10 August Gazette extends PM E-DRIVE to March 2028. Neither is an August registration print.
ideas.detail: The exact August national EV-registration claim could not be verified from an official release.
ideas.kill_condition: The candidate remains rejected unless an official August national dataset and exact issuer allocation are archived.

ideas.title: Kmart / Anko smart ring
ideas.why: Wesfarmers owns Kmart Group; its FY2025 results explicitly say Anko Global revenue and earnings were immaterial to Kmart Group.
ideas.detail: Three Kmart smart-ring aliases rose, but the frozen evidence does not verify an issuer-scale product launch or paid demand.
ideas.kill_condition: Reopen only with verified Kmart product identity plus sustained sell-through large enough to affect a disclosed category or Kmart earnings.

ideas.title: Mediterranean marine heat
ideas.why: The archived bulletin is real but covers the first half, not a clean late-summer event window, and it does not map to a security.
ideas.detail: Copernicus reports January-June Mediterranean SST of 18.07°C, 98% basin marine-heatwave coverage and about 80% in strong/severe/extreme conditions.
ideas.kill_condition: No dated late-summer event or issuer-specific operational impact.

ideas.title: Named data-centre projects: Yondr, Colt, PDG, Colossus and Uptown Charlotte
ideas.why: DigitalBridge's primary release verifies Yondr ownership and more than 420 MW committed to hyperscalers. That does not create an entry: SoftBank agreed to acquire all DBRG common stock for USD16 cash, expected in second-half 2026; DBRG closed at USD15.94 on 3 September.
ideas.detail: The named-project screen found a real listed relationship for Yondr that the first pass missed: a DigitalBridge/La Caisse acquisition. Other names were private, collided with another geography, or lacked primary issuer materiality.
ideas.catalyst: SoftBank acquisition close, not the search signal.
ideas.kill_condition: A project thesis cannot outrun a near-cash merger cap without a separate merger-arbitrage view; that was not established.

ideas.title: Norway August EV registrations
ideas.why: The official page is preserved but direct archival reset the connection; search-index extracts provided the exact totals. The milestone is penetration, not a positive market-volume shock.
ideas.detail: OFV indexed 13,451 new passenger-car registrations for August, down 3.35% year over year, while zero-emission share reached 98.68%.
ideas.catalyst: Subsequent official brand/model registrations and issuer commentary showing sustained share or regional volume change.
ideas.kill_condition: Market volume continues to fall or company-specific volumes do not improve.

ideas.title: onn. 4K Pro streaming device
instruments: Walmart Inc. common stock, Nasdaq: WMT
ideas.why: The product behavior is real, but no device-level revenue, units, margin or defensible bound exists, so one low-ticket SKU cannot support a material Walmart thesis.
ideas.next_check: Issuer or retailer disclosure of onn. units or category economics
ideas.kill_condition: Repeated normal availability without broad repeat purchasing, or continued absence of a defensible earnings bridge.

ideas.title: Pacific marine heatwave and El Niño
ideas.why: The climate event is real. The multi-country Rising readings remain separately normalized and are not summed or ranked as absolute demand.
ideas.detail: NOAA declared El Niño and a 63% chance of monitored Pacific temperatures exceeding 2.0°C, while NOAA Fisheries described possible West Coast species and salmon impacts.

signals.query: pacific marine heatwave and el nino
pacific marine heatwave and el nino

ideas.kill_condition: No exact geography-company exposure, or the event does not affect issuer volumes, prices, mortality or costs.

ideas.title: Queensland heatwave to cooling demand
ideas.why: The mechanism is valid. The current event was not.
ideas.detail: Official sources support the structural link from heat to air-conditioning and electricity demand. But the BOM heatwave service was out of season and no current Queensland heatwave warning was verified. Without a current event, sell-through or load evidence, there is no company catalyst.

ideas.title: R.H. Macy & Co. fine jewelry
instruments: Macy's, Inc. common stock, NYSE: M
ideas.why: The evidence mixes stale threads, deep-discount fashion jewelry and quality complaints, while Macy's does not disclose fine-jewelry sales or item-level owned versus Marketplace economics.
ideas.kill_condition: Do not revive a positive thesis without fresh repeated Macy's-nameplate purchases, seller attribution, low returns and category economics.

ideas.title: Same-day pet-food delivery
ideas.why: No primary evidence bound these queries to Chewy or another listed operator; assigning NYSE:CHWY would be ticker inference from a category.
ideas.detail: Four generic delivery-intent aliases rose; none names a provider.
ideas.kill_condition: Reopen only after an exact operator/service relationship and provider-specific orders, adoption or economics are verified.

ideas.title: The Matrix streaming availability
ideas.why: Consumer friction is real; the earnings path is microscopic and unresolved.
ideas.detail: Viewers hunt across free, rental, digital, physical and subscription access. Warner Bros. Discovery is the rights-owner path, but no title-level transaction, subscription, advertising or retention data exists. This is a viewing-friction observation, not an investable signal.

signals.query: +80% Rising worldwide, now 7 days; history not requested

ideas.title: UK Tier 1 streaming regulation
ideas.why: GOV.UK names Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+ and UK services and states catalogue accessibility thresholds of 80% subtitled, 10% audio-described and 5% signed. The exact compliance cost is not disclosed.
ideas.detail: The UK announced enhanced Ofcom rules for large video-on-demand services with more than 500,000 UK users, including accessibility and content standards.
ideas.catalyst: Publication/effect of final Ofcom codes and any designation list.
ideas.kill_condition: Rules are narrowed/delayed, implementation costs are immaterial, or no differentiated issuer impact appears.

ideas.title: US PHIT fitness-expense bill
ideas.why: Official bill text covers qualifying fitness expenses and exercise equipment, capped at USD1,000 per taxpayer or USD2,000 for joint/head-of-household returns.
ideas.detail: The query implied a home-gym deduction, but H.R.2369 remains an introduced bill referred to House Ways and Means, not enacted policy.
ideas.catalyst: Committee markup or passage with operative equipment/subscription language.
ideas.kill_condition: The bill remains stalled, is narrowed or excludes relevant equipment/subscriptions.

ideas.title: Jeju Air
instruments: Jeju Air Co., Ltd.; KOSPI code 089590 (instrument code corroborated by secondary market data; exact KRX instrument page was unavailable)
ideas.why: The service maps directly to a listed airline and demand can matter, but the evidence does not separate Jeju Air share gain from generic Korea travel; 1H revenue recovery still produced a net loss and accident-related liabilities remain incompletely quantified.
ideas.kill_condition: Passenger growth without load-factor/yield improvement, no share gain versus peers, or material unresolved accident costs.
